messages:
Maria: quick follow-up from the batching compaction discussioni want to float a 'soft-compact' proposal: prefer keeping small live windows for brief periods to avoid penalizing low-qps tenants. looking for tradeoff feedback.
AJ: can you outline differences vs current aggressive compaction? i.e., what changes at enqueue vs eviction time?
Maria: current: compactor merges small windows every cycle once they hit age threshold. soft-compact: allow windows <S sized to survive until either (a) they reach a short max_delay (eg 20-50ms) OR (b) global memory pressure or per-tenant KV pressure forces compaction. enqueue path unchanged.
Devon: so we trade a bit of memory and packing efficiency for better p99 for low-volume tenants. sounds sensible. metrics-wise we need live_window_count and live_window_ms.
Sam: can tenants opt out? some customers prefer predictable cost.
Maria: yes, plan is tenant-configurable with sane defaults. sample config names: soft_compact.enabled, soft_compact.max_delay_ms, soft_compact.memory_pressure_pct, soft_compact.tenant_override_flag.
AJ: two risks: 1) holding windows longer increases KV cache residency per-tenant (more GPU memory). 2) noisy tenants could game live windows to pin resources and degrade other tenants.
Kevin: tie into KV-cache signals: compactor should accept a kvcache_pressure signal per-tenant and ignore soft delays when kvcache share > threshold. also add a per-host emergency compaction flag.
Devon: for noisy tenant fairness, we can charge a usage-lever: token-bucket that debits live_window_ms at enqueue/time-slice. when bucket drained, compactor treats tenant as 'greedy' and compacts aggressively. token refill rate based on tier and SLA.
Maria: i like token-bucket + kvcache signal. token metric: live_window_ms_per_minute sampled per tenant. will include audit logs when compaction overrides soft delay.
Sam: rollout plan? i'd canary on a subset of hosts and gather per-route p50/p99 and token-bucket exhaustion events. make sure we track per-tenant cost delta.
Infra-bot: deploying experiment: canary-3 soft_compact.enabled=true max_delay_ms=30 memory_pressure_pct=85.
AJ: observability additions: live_window_ms histogram, live_window_count, per-tenant kvcache_share, token_bucket_level, compaction_override_count. attach these to the rollout dashboard and wire alerts for sustained token exhaustion (>5s) and cost delta >10%.
Devon: add a debug/admin endpoint that returns live windows for a tenant (ids, size, age, reason kept) -- gated by admin role and sampling TTL. helpful during incident triage.
Maria: defaults: off for free/low tiers, on for pro/enterprise. auto-disable if a tenant's cost delta exceeds X% or host memory_pressure hits Y.
Kevin: plus an emergency admin API to trigger immediate hard compact on host or tenant. implement RBAC check.
Maria: next steps: i'll draft a short RFC addendum with config names, token math, kvcache thresholds, and canary plan. volunteers?
Devon: i'll take the debug endpoint.
Sam: i'll own dashboards and alerts.
AJ: i'll review the RFC and sanity-check latency impact numbers.
Maria: thanks everyone. i'll post RFC link when ready. :rocket:
Infra-bot: canary metrics posted: https://deploys.redwood.example/canary-3/1718459999
